Earlier this May, Lux Optics launched the all-new Halide Mark III professional camera app, designed specifically for the iPhone. Today, Halide is rolling out its first update, adding support for the iPhone 18 Pro, along with a host of new features for all iPhone photography enthusiasts.

The mission of Halide Mark III is to help iPhone users capture better photos.

These include a redesigned camera interface, a brand-new photo editor, and Halide Looks, which allow you to apply specific styles to your photos.

Halide 3.1 was released in July, adding another Halide Look and more features on top of the existing foundation.

  • Halide Mark III professional iPhone camera app brings three major photography upgrades
  • Halide 3.1 adds perspective correction, pure RAW shooting and other new features

Halide 3.2 is now officially released, perfectly complementing the upgraded iPhone 18 Pro camera system.

Aperture Priority Mode

The new version introduces Aperture Priority Mode, further unlocking Halide's capabilities and allowing users to choose any aperture value between ƒ/1.48 and ƒ/4.0.

(The built-in "Camera" app supports automatic variable aperture mode, and also allows manual selection of ƒ/1.48, ƒ/1.8, ƒ/2.8 or ƒ/4.0.)

Halide 3.2's Aperture Priority Mode, designed for the iPhone 18 Pro, lets you set a target aperture value, after which Halide will automatically adjust shutter speed and ISO based on the shooting environment.

Full Manual Mode gives you direct control over ISO.

All-new Halide Looks: dawn and quicksilver

In addition, Halide 3.2 also brings two new styles to all iPhones: dawn and quicksilver.

dawn "brings cinematic warm tones to the midtones and highlights, paired with soft, layered shadows"; while quicksilver "features high-contrast, low-saturation colours, inspired by the silver halide archival printing technique".

Finally, Halide 3.2 also adds a 16:9 aspect ratio shooting mode.

Halide Mark III is available as a one-time purchase for US$69.99; the subscription plan is US$19.99 per year, which unlocks full access to the new app.
